title: Physics agents and unmeasured requirements: pre-registered studies, agent transcripts and analysis scripts
description: Data deposit for the article "Physics Agents Report Unmeasured Requirements as Met. A Test of the McNamara Fallacy". It contains the pre-registrations (with SHA-256 freeze manifests and deviation logs), task scenarios, agent harnesses, full transcripts and results of more than 1,000 language-model agent runs on particle-physics design tasks, the blind re-coding of archived GRACE runs, the decision-level vignette responses, and the scripts that reproduce every reported number. Confirmatory studies C2, C3 and C4 were frozen before data collection; see the git tags c2-frozen and c3-frozen and the FREEZE_*.md files. See README.md for contents and reproduction.
notes: Funding: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program, Grant No. DGE-2139757. API credits from Anthropic's AI for Science program. Data: CC BY 4.0. Scripts: MIT.
